speaker: gauge
text: This bird is on a live power line. It needs rubber boots.

speaker: fitz
text: Electricity needs a voltage difference to flow. Both feet sit on one wire, at the same voltage. So almost no current goes through the bird.

speaker: gauge
text: Then how do birds get hurt?

speaker: fitz
text: Big wings. A wing can touch a second wire, or a grounded part of the pole. Bird-safe poles space wires wider than big wings, and cover risky parts.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
